prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production fantasy adventure videogame UI atlas, not website buttons. ONE 1536x1024 landscape image with six different long horizontal blank button components, strictly 2 columns x 3 rows. Each isolated component is about 640px wide, 160px tall, centered in its 768x341 cell. Genuine transparent background between and around components.
Visual baseline: bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy with 2.5D sculptural volume, high three-quarter view of decorative features, warm upper-left sunlight, fresh vivid colours, consistent crisp dark ink outlines and material scale. Sophisticated adventure RPG for ages 18–30. Artwork should feel like crafted objects in an enchanted explorer workshop. Crisp painterly shadows, clear interesting silhouettes, specific physical materials. NOT muddy pastel watercolour, NOT generic rounded web button, NOT six identical golden frames.
Caption engineering: each face is horizontal and clearly readable, with a large calm central blank surface, at least 75% of total width. NO letters/numbers. Decorative feature confined to small outer left corner or edge, must never extend into the caption. Only modest narrow trim. Each family is distinct:
Top left PRIMARY: rich cobalt and turquoise glazed rune-stone plaque with clean faceted corners, a tiny luminous amber crystal embedded at far left edge, thin bronze joint only at two ends. Subtle 2.5D thickness underneath and sunlit rim. Dark blue spacious blank caption face.
Top right SECONDARY: warm ivory adventure-journal slip held by asymmetrical light honey-wood corners, a tiny teal leather binding at left. Broad flat cream center, sophisticated fine warm outline, softly irregular hand-crafted edge.
Middle left NAVIGATION: fresh deep teal leaf-and-leather nameplate, small two-leaf cluster tucked behind upper left edge, clean slightly tapered long silhouette, dark teal blank caption face, subtle cream stitching ONLY on edge.
Middle right RETURN: cream painted wooden trail sign, small brass compass-ring fitting on extreme left, pointed left end, short sunlit wood thickness, wide blank cream face.
Bottom left SELL/DANGER: burnt coral varnished workshop tile with clean clipped corners, tiny copper clasp and one short leather loop at far left, wide coral face, sculpted lower depth, dark elegant ink outline.
Bottom right EQUIPMENT CARD: broad ivory item-label frame, thin warm brass corners and a small blue cloth fold outside top left, clean cream central face. Quiet functional thin border, no imposing metal rails.
Maintain high quality hand-painted fantasy illustration detail at edges and completely quiet interiors. Avoid rolled scroll ends, rivets everywhere, thick gold/metal perimeter rails, glitter, toys, faces, swords across text, huge gemstones, heavy vines, tassels, muddy backgrounds, pills, checkerboard baked into image, text, watermarks. All six fully visible with ample transparent space, clean alpha-cut silhouettes.
usage: Six purpose-specific UI materials, original pixels preserved; live captions and nine-slice scaling.
